text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock D and Stock B for gains, then bought Stock B back at a higher price; I should base trades on future prospects, not the comfort of locking in gains.","I tend to judge each stock against its purchase price and resist admitting mistakes; I should reassess each holding objectively rather than let its average cost dictate my decision.","My account value moved both down and up while I made no trades; I should avoid reacting to small monthly changes and make deliberate decisions consistent with my overall portfolio." ]}
